{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 1:00). Notes are based only on what I saw and heard. I don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting or blaming anyone for the build itself yet.

Hana: Acting as coordinator. At 0:45 she told Sofia and Jack to start their strokes once the lines reach them, and said she'd call a rethink if needed. Clear, calm direction, early sign of leadership and collaboration. I don't yet know if she placed dominoes herself. She said Omar's tail will continue once 'your line reaches the middle', so she seems to own the main line.

Omar: Proactive and clear. At 0:30 he named the fish, claimed the upper tail (stroke 3) and said he'd start it straight away. Good communication and ownership. A pale (unconnected) chain runs from about x8 to x15 on the upper side, with a small gap at the junction with the connected line. This may be his section, but I didn't see who placed it. A gap like that could break the chain, so I need to check on the next visit that it gets bridged.

Sofia: Nothing observed. She said nothing while I was there and I can't tell what she's doing. I have no basis for a rating yet. Check in next visit.

Jack: Same as Sofia. He was told to start his stroke when the lines arrive, so he may be waiting on others. Watch whether he's idle or just sequenced.

Team: The connected lines already form two long arms from the start (upper to about x8, lower to about x12). The upper tail is pale and disconnected, the main risk right now. Next visit: check the gap closes, see what Sofia and Jack are doing, and ask people privately who did what."}
